description: Regenerate pnpm-lock.yaml weekly (Renovate's default schedule, before 4am on Monday) so transitive dependencies move to the latest versions their parents allow. Regular updates only bump direct dependencies, so vulnerable transitive versions otherwise stay pinned until Dependabot flags them.

minimumReleaseAge is null because a lock file maintenance PR has no release timestamp: with the top-level 3 days and the default minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour (timestamp-required), Renovate would hold it forever. pnpm still refuses versions published less than its own minimumReleaseAge ago (1 day by default since pnpm v11) while regenerating the lock file.
Automerged like the other groups: with platformAutomerge: false, Renovate merges only once every check, e2e included, is green.

packageRules.description: E2E testing (Playwright). Automerged: the e2e workflow runs on the PR, and with top-level platformAutomerge: false Renovate only merges once every check (e2e included) is green. If platformAutomerge is turned back on, GitHub auto-merge waits only for required checks, so e2e would no longer gate
web-ext (used by WXT to run the extension in a browser)
Node.js types follow the Node.js major used in CI (22.x)
Digest updates of pinned GitHub Actions may have no release timestamp, which minimumReleaseAge would hold indefinitely

Do not automerge minor updates of 0.x packages (e.g. @types/chrome 0.2 -> 0.3, wxt 0.21 -> 0.22): a 0.x minor bump can be breaking. matchCurrentVersion uses the locked version, so it works with range specifiers like ^0.3.0
Do not automerge major version updates
